programme.desc: 1998. Hosted by Antoine de Caunes. We meet a Spanish siren with castanets, meet Finland's biggest slappers, Lolo dives deep down with her snorkel and one man goes down in medical history.

programme.title: Yanky Panky
programme.desc: 2000. Join country music persona Tina C as she uncovers the eccentric subcultures, bizarre personalities, and the rude, crude and lewd underbelly of American society.

programme.title: The Hitch-Hiker
programme.desc: 1953. Thriller. Director Ida Lupino. Stars Edmond O'Brien, Frank Lovejoy & William Talman. Ray & Gilbert's fishing trip takes a turn when they pick up a hitch-hiker who turns out to be on the run.

programme.title: The Day Time Ended
programme.desc: 1979. Sci-Fi. Director: John Cardos. Stars Jim Davis, Christopher Mitchum & Dorothy Malone. Aliens visit the house of a family. The house is sucked into a time warp that sends it back in time.

programme.title: One Step Beyond
programme.desc: Who Are You? 1960. Stars Philip Bourneuf & Anna Lee. After a young girl recovers from scarlet fever, she rejects her parents and insists she is the recently deceased daughter of another family.

programme.title: Down Among The Z Men
programme.desc: 1952. Comedy directed by Maclean Rogers and starring Michael Bentine, Harry Secombe, Spike Milligan and Peter Sellers. Prof. Pureheart loses a secret formula in the grocery shop.

programme.title: Scotland Yard
programme.desc: 1959. The Unseeing Eye. Directed by Geoffrey Muller. Starring Russell Napier, John Stone and Denny Dayviss. A night worker returning home sees smoke and flames coming from a building. (S1, E30)

programme.title: Sherlock Holmes
programme.desc: The Case of the Split Ticket. 1954. Starring: Ronald Howard, Howard Marion-Crawford & Archie Duncan. When O'Casey wins the lottery, they must find Albert before the ticket runs out.

programme.title: The Brave Don't Cry
programme.desc: 1952. Drama. Directed by Philip Leacock. Starring John Gregson, Meg Buchanan & John Rae. Based on a true story. In a small Scots mining-town, a mine cave-in seals the entire crew.

programme.title: X The Unknown
programme.desc: 1956. Fantasy. Directed by Leslie Norman. Stars Dean Jagger, Edward Chapman & Leo McKern. A radioactive creature terrorises a remote Scottish village, will anyone be able to stop it?

programme.title: North West Frontier
programme.desc: 1959. Drama. Director: J. Lee Thompson. Stars Kenneth More, Lauren Bacall & Herbert Lom. In British India, a prince must be taken to safety across a rebel-held territory.

programme.title: Water World
programme.desc: 2000. Actor and canal enthusiast Timothy West narrates the story of the incredible engineering feats needed to build canals and meets some of the characters to be found on inland waterways today.

programme.title: That's My Boy
programme.desc: Surprise, Surprise. 1985. Stars Mollie Sugden, Deddie Davies & Eric Francis. Ida drops hints about what she wants for her upcoming birthday, but when it arrives she ends up disappointed.

programme.title: For the Love of Ada
programme.desc: Birth. Stars: Wilfred Pickles, Irene Handl & Jack Smethurst. Ada is about to become a grandmother but when Ruth's baby arrives, Leslie is at first nowhere to be found. (S4, E03)

programme.title: The Man from U.N.C.L.E
programme.desc: The Waverly Ring Affair. 1966. Stars Robert Vaughn, David McCallum & Larry Blyden. THRUSH has a mole inside New York headquarters. Solo and Kuryakin are assigned to root out the double agent.

programme.title: The Footage Detectives
programme.desc: This week's first stop is Piccadilly Roundabout in 1944 wartime London, there's a slice of history from a bread factory in 1966, a reel of 1950s Italy and a look at the history of Baxter's.

programme.title: Enemy At The Door
programme.desc: Pains And Penalties. 1978. Stars: Alfred Burke, Bernard Horsfall. Dr. Martel arranges hospitalisation for frail old Mrs. Bree who, with her son Edward, are rent-free tenants of Peter.

programme.title: Jigsaw
programme.desc: 1962. Directed by Val Guest and starring Jack Warner. A woman is murdered and it's up to Detective Fellows to sift through the clues and solve the 'Jigsaw'. Great shots of Brighton in the 60s.

programme.title: Fox
programme.desc: Just An Iron Monkey. 1980. Stars Bernard Hill, Mary Peach & Lee Walker. Vin tries to sort out his finances so he can buy a country pub. Ray is also offered a good business proposition.

programme.title: An Innocent Man
programme.desc: 1989. Crime Drama. Directed by Peter Yates. Stars Tom Selleck, F. Murray Abraham & Laila Robins. Two corrupt cops send an innocent man to prison, leading him to seek revenge on his release.

programme.title: The Heritage Chart Show with Mike Read
programme.desc: A TOTP style TV Show for Heritage Artists based on the Heritage Chart which is voted on in over 80 countries. Songs you love from popular artists, live and on video with the odd interview.

programme.title: Play of the Month: Robinson Crusoe
programme.desc: 1974. Drama. Director: James MacTaggart. Stars Stanley Baker, Ram John Holder & Jerome Willis. A man struggles to survive after being shipwrecked on a deserted island.

programme.title: Three Silent Men
programme.desc: 1940. Crime. An inventor of a deadly weapon to be used against the allies is injured in a crash. Surgeon, Sir James (Sebastian Shaw) saves his life but learns of his plot. Stars Derrick De Marney.

programme.title: The Adventures of Robin Hood
programme.desc: The Hero. 1956. Stars Richard Greene, Bill Owen & John Dearth. After the sheriff's brother is killed, the man responsible is taken in by Robin, but tensions soon rise as he struggles to fit in.

programme.title: Supercar
programme.desc: The Lost City. 1961. Stars David Graham, George Murcell & Graydon Gould. On the way to the South Pole, an uncontrolled force lands them on a strange island where they are in danger.

programme.title: The Vise
programme.desc: The Rattan Trunk. 1955. Stars Ron Randell, Peter Grant & Jan Holden. Bert Edwards receives a trunk full of Persian rugs. Soon after the luggage turns up at Euston Station with a body inside.

programme.title: The Detectives
programme.desc: Conspiracy Of Silence. Captain Matt Holbrook (Robert Taylor) leads a squad of brave and tough detectives tackling crime. Also Stars: Tige Andrews, Russell Thorson, Adam West.

programme.title: The Great Van Robbery
programme.desc: 1959. Crime Drama. Director: Max Varnel. Stars Denis Shaw, Kay Callard & Tony Quinn. An Interpol detective pursues a dangerous thief who has placed his loot into a bank account in Rio de Janeiro.

programme.title: Morocco
programme.desc: 1930. Romance. Director: Josef von Sternberg. Stars Gary Cooper, Marlene Dietrich & Adolphe Menjou. A night club singer and a Legionnaire fall in love, but their relationship becomes complicated.

programme.title: Salvage with a Smile 1940
programme.desc: 1940. Second World War comedy short explaining the value of salvage with Kathleen Harrison and Ronald Shiner, made at Ealing Studios.

programme.title: Z-Cars
programme.desc: Guns. 1976. Stars Ray Lonnen, Albert Welling & John Cording. Armed robbery is becoming almost a daily event and soon someone will get hurt. What happens if the police meet violence with violence?

programme.title: Della
programme.desc: 1964. Drama. Director: Robert Gist and starring Joan Crawford. Della (Crawford), a reclusive matriarch of Royal Bay, watches over the affluent coastal town. Possession, for her, is everything.

programme.title: Banking a Banana
programme.desc: 1961. A previously lost comedy short, starring Spike Milligan, about using bananas as a form of currency.

programme.title: Richard the Lionheart
programme.desc: The Man Who Sold Pardons. 1963. Stars Dermot Walsh, Nigel Green & Robin Hunter. A charlatan posing as a monk is going through towns selling indulgences, bearing a forged document from the king!

programme.title: Send For Paul Temple
programme.desc: 1946. Crime Drama. Directed by John Argyle. Starring Anthony Hulme and Joy Shelton. Scotland Yard calls in novelist and amateur detective Paul Temple to help track down a gang of diamond robbers.

programme.title: Film Noir
programme.desc: Origins of Noir. 2022. The origins of Film Noir begin with the industrial revolution and with the ideas that that form of mechanised production produces.

programme.title: Blithe Spirit
programme.desc: 1945. Comedy. Director: David Lean. Stars Rex Harrison, Constance Cummings, Kay Hammond, Margaret Rutherford. A newly-married writer and his second wife are haunted by the ghost of his first wife.

programme.title: Look At Life A Flight of Fancy
programme.desc: 1961. How does a homing pigeon 'home'? This film takes a look at the development of the birds, from fledglings to long-distance champions.

programme.title: Scales of Justice
programme.desc: 1965. The Material Witness. Stars Edgar Lustgarten & John Carlin. A young executive plots to replace a firm's manager, and turns him in to police as a drunk driver. (S1, E09)

programme.title: The Footage Detectives
programme.desc: Mike and Noel step back to 1947 with warnings for curious children, then it's off to Sweden for a little nostalgia from 1957 and the detectives talk fireworks 50s style and explosive escapades.

programme.title: Maigret
programme.desc: Maigret Versus Mr Cavre. 1997. Stars Bruno Cremer, Nade Dieu & Jacques Boudet. Maigret travels to a small town in Belgium to help a friend whose brother-in-law has been accused of murder.

programme.title: Adventures of a Plumber's Mate
programme.desc: 1978. Comedy. Director: Stanley Long. Stars Chris Neil, Christopher Biggins, Lindy Benson. Plumber's mate Sid meets ladies at work. Susie is unaware of his dalliances as he gets into debt trouble.

programme.title: Murders In...
programme.desc: Murders in Martinique - Meurtres en Martinique. 2016. Director: Philippe Niang. Stars Sara Martins & Olivier Marchal. Parisian forensic specialist helps in an investigation near Mount Pelée.

programme.title: Birmingham & The Road Patrol Bikes
programme.desc: Glimpses: 1950s. We start in Birmingham at the famous BSA factory where we follow the annual Road Patrol. Marvel at their side chassis and box carriers and follow them to Exeter, Abroath & Belfast.

programme.title: The Lawless Years
programme.desc: The Muddy Kasoff Story. 1959. Stars James Gregory, Nita Talbot, Robert Karnes. Barney Ruditsky investigates the murder of Muddy Kasoff, using minimal clues to track down the gangsters responsible.

programme.title: Mrs Mike
programme.desc: 1949. Drama. Director: Louis King. Stars Dick Powell, Evelyn Keyes & J.M Kerrigan. Kathy O'Fallon meets Mountie Mike Flannigan. They fall in love, but can their love survive?

programme.title: Star Performance: The Book
programme.desc: 1954. Drama. Directed by Roy Kellino. Stars David Niven, Marguerite Chapman & Douglas Fowley. An author's curiosity about a piece of paper found in a library book leads him to a group of spies.

programme.title: Look At Life Glorious Mud
programme.desc: 1960. An entertaining look at the role mud plays in all of our lives.

programme.title: Batman
programme.desc: Marsha, Queen of Diamonds. 1966. Stars Adam West, Carolyn Jones & Estelle Winwood. Batman and Robin attempt to foil Marsha, Queen of Diamonds' plan to steal the Batcomputer's power source.

programme.title: Batman
programme.desc: Marsha's Scheme of Diamonds. 1966. Stars Adam West, Carolyn Jones & Woody Strode. Marsha searches for a new potion to use on the Caped Crusaders in an attempt to obtain the Batcave's bat-diamond.

programme.title: The Broken Melody
programme.desc: 1934. Directed by Bernard Vorhaus. Paul Verlaine, a struggling composer (John Garrick) is supported by Germaine (Merle Oberon) who is secretly in love with him.

programme.title: The Mysterious Mr Nicholson
programme.desc: 1947. Crime drama. Directed by Oswald Mitchell and starring Anthony Hulme, Lesley Osmond and Frank Hawkins. A solicitors' clerk is sent to deliver a will and finds the recipient murdered.

programme.title: Up The River
programme.desc: 1930. Comedy. Directed by John Ford. Stars Spencer Tracy, Claire Luce & Humphrey Bogart. When a paroled convict and former inmate are blackmailed, two career criminals come to their rescue.

programme.title: Terror By Night
programme.desc: 1946. Crime Drama. Starring: Basil Rathbone, Nigel Bruce & Alan Mowbray. When a diamond is stolen on a train and the son of its owner is murdered, everybody is a suspect to Sherlock Holmes.

programme.title: Scotland Yard
programme.desc: 1956. Person Unknown. Directed by Montgomery Tully. Starring Russell Napier, Edward Cast and Alan Robinson. A Polish spy changed places with a would-be assassin. (S1, E18)

programme.title: William Tell
programme.desc: The Spider. 1959. Stars Conrad Phillips & Donald Pleasence. Austrian commander 'The Spider' captures two of Tell's men and threatens to torture them. Now Tell must infiltrate The Spider's ranks.

programme.title: Rage at Dawn
programme.desc: 1955. Western. Directed by Tim Whelan. Stars Randolph Scott, Forrest Tucker & Mala Powers. A private detective from Chicago is sent out west to take down the notorious Reno brothers.

programme.title: Out of the Fog
programme.desc: 1962. Crime drama directed by Montgomery Tully. An ex-con is the prime suspect when a series of murders occur under a full moon. Every victim is a blonde young woman. Starring David Sumner.

programme.title: Daily Sketch Jigsaw Puzzle 1938
programme.desc: Take a nostalgic trip back to 1938 with this short film about the Daily Sketch's jigsaw puzzle.

programme.title: Storm Over the Nile
programme.desc: 1955. Directors: Zoltan Korda & Terence Young. Stars Anthony Steel & Laurence Harvey. A British officer is accused of cowardice by his friends and woman he loves. He sets out to prove his courage.

programme.title: The Man from U.N.C.L.E
programme.desc: The Waverly Ring Affair. 1966. Stars Robert Vaughn, David McCallum & Larry Blyden. THRUSH has a mole inside New York headquarters. Solo and Kuryakin are assigned to root out the double agent.

programme.title: Hannay
programme.desc: A Point of Honour. 1988. Stars Robert Powell, Christopher Scoular & Gavin Richards. An encounter with a young lady on a train leads to a strange weekend of mistaken identity and danger.

programme.title: An Englishman Abroad
programme.desc: 1983. Drama. Director: John Schlesinger. Stars Alan Bates, Coral Browne & Charles Gray. Based on a true story, actress Coral Browne has a chance meeting with a member of the Cambridge spy ring.

programme.title: Run Wild, Run Free
programme.desc: 1969. Drama. Directed by Richard C. Sarafian. Stars John Mills, Sylvia Syms & Gordon Jackson. A psychosomatically mute young boy finds an emotional release through his love for a wild white colt.

programme.title: The House Across the Street
programme.desc: Be a good neighbour.... until you can't. A woman notices some very disturbing things about her new small town neighborhood. With the help of a police officer, who also thinks that the town is hiding something, she attempts to unravel the sinister mystery

programme.title: The Dark Night of the Scarecrow
programme.desc: A lynch mob pursues a mentally handicapped man whom they believe to have brutally attacked a girl, only to find out after they have killed him that he was trying to protect her from a vicious dog. A mysterious scarecrow later appears out of nowhere in the town and comes to life to punish those responsible for the crime. Horror, starring Charles Durning and Robert F Lyons

programme.title: The Terror
programme.desc: A young French soldier cut off from his unit in Napoleon's army is beguiled by a mysterious woman, whom he learns is the wife of an elderly Baron - and that she seemingly died twenty years earlier. Horror, starring Boris Karloff and Jack Nicholson

programme.title: Gorgo
programme.desc: Monster adventure starring Bill Travers and William Sylvester. A prehistoric monster is captured off the coast of Ireland and brought to London where it is exhibited in a circus. But having determined that the monster is an infant, scientists suspect that one of its parents may also still be alive.

programme.title: Love Under the Stars
programme.desc: With a little help from a young girl and a widower, a woman in her 30s finally grows up and takes on the real world. Romantic comedy, starring Ashley Newbrough, Barry Bostwick and Wes Brown

programme.title: Cooking with Love
programme.desc: Television producer Kelly is faced with the unexpected when a hot-headed chef becomes the new host of her cooking show. Romantic comedy, starring Ali Liebert

programme.title: The 39 Steps
programme.desc: Classic thriller starring Robert Donat and Madeleine Carroll. An innocent man accused of murder is pursued by both the police and an international spy ring. The beleaguered Richard Hannay finds himself fleeing across the desolate Scottish moors handcuffed to a beautiful woman.

programme.title: Charro
programme.desc: Western starring Elvis Presley. Reformed gunman Jess Wade is lured to a Mexican border town by his former companions, only to be framed for the theft of a priceless Victory gun - a cannon cast in precious metals. In an attempt to prove his innocence, Jess is forced to risk his own life and the possible destruction of an entire town.

programme.title: Love, Game, Match
programme.desc: New-in-town teacher Liz agrees to help test her students' matchmaking website. So will it be singles or doubles when she meets tennis coach Ted? Romantic comedy, starring Cristine Prosperi and Dale Moss

programme.title: A Horse for Spring
programme.desc: Riley Adams’s dreams of being a world class elite dancer are shattered following an horrific accident. A surprising act of kindness from a most unexpected place helps Riley discover the power of faith, friendship and love in this charming tale. AKA Healed by Grace

programme.title: Detective McLean
programme.desc: Allison and Devin investigate the death of a high-powered CEO. Meanwhile, Cameron and Mariah's mother, Jackie comes home from rehab.

programme.title: Detective McLean
programme.desc: Allison and Devin uncover the shocking truth at the heart of a turf war in Crestview. Later, Allison and Matt take the entire family to visit Tim in prison and Jackie, feeling jealous of the way Cameron looks up to Allison, makes a tragic choice.

programme.title: Sherlock Holmes and the Leading Lady
programme.desc: An Austrian scientist offers to provide the British government with his experimental new bomb, and Holmes is sent to Vienna to collect it. Before he can take delivery, the device is stolen and he must recover it before several other interested parties get their hands on it. Mystery, with Christopher Lee, Patrick Macnee, Morgan Fairchild and John Bennett

programme.title: Zulu
programme.desc: Historical war drama starring Stanley Baker, Michael Caine and Jack Hawkins. In 1879, Cetewayo, ruler of the great Zulu kingdom, inflicts a heavy defeat upon the British army at Isandhlwana and marches towards the small garrison of Rorke's Drift, where two officers desperately rally their meagre forces.

programme.title: Man Down
programme.desc: Former US Marine Gabriel Drummer returns home from Afghanistan and searches for the whereabouts of his son, accompanied by his best friend. Drama, starring Shia LaBeouf, Jai Courtney and Kate Mara

programme.title: The Pirates of Somalia
programme.desc: Based on a shocking true story and starring Evan Peters (Xmen franchise), Barkhad Abdi (Captain Philips) with an appearance from Al Pacino (The Godfather). In search of a unique and worthy story, an aspiring journalist travels to Somalia to write about the life of the Pirates. But he soon becomes embroiled in a dark and dangerous fight which will risk everything, including his life. Sensational!

programme.title: Keep the Aspidistra Flying
programme.desc: Period romantic comedy based on the satirical novel by George Orwell, starring Richard E Grant and Helena Bonham Carter. When a successful copywriter abandons his career to become a poet, it's up to his long-suffering girlfriend to keep their relationship on the rails.

programme.title: Love, Game, Match
programme.desc: New-in-town teacher Liz agrees to help test her students' matchmaking website. So will it be singles or doubles when she meets tennis coach Ted? Romantic comedy, starring Cristine Prosperi and Dale Moss

programme.title: Candid about Love
programme.desc: Laura, a gallery assistant and wannabe fine art photographer, is finally promised a spot in a Newcomer’s Showcase - but only if she can get a reclusive artist, Shane, to premiere his newest photographs at the gallery. When Laura discovers that Shane hasn’t taken a new photo in ten years, she’s determined to help him find his way back to his art whether he wants her to or not.

programme.title: A Hazard of Hearts
programme.desc: A girl's gambling-mad father loses her to his arch-enemy, a debauched nobleman, in a game of dice. Period drama based on Barbara Cartland's novel, starring Helena Bonham Carter, Diana Rigg, Edward Fox, Marcus Gilbert and Anna Massey

programme.title: A Star Is Born
programme.desc: Classic drama starring Janet Gaynor and Fredric March. Declining Hollywood movie star Norman Maine meets young waitress Esther Blodgett at a party and promises to make her a star. But as her career goes from strength to strength, Maine's continues to go downhill.

programme.title: A Snapshot of Forever
programme.desc: A wedding photographer's happy small town life is turned upside down when a famous Hollywood actor shows up at her parent's lakeside vineyard for his sister's wedding. Romantic comedy, starring Natalie Dreyfuss and Anthony Konechny

programme.title: Bridal Boot Camp
programme.desc: Romantic comedy starring Spencer Locke and Jake Sandvig. Andy attempts to become the "perfect" bride-to-be by attending a niche training camp, but comes to question her engagement when she meets a cynical delivery man.

programme.title: Northpole
programme.desc: Seasonal fantasy starring Tiffani Thiessen and Max Charles. With everyone now seemingly too busy to enjoy Christmas the way they used to, Santa's home and livelihood come under threat. But young Kevin still believes, and together with his teacher and some new friends sets out to show just how magical the festive season can be.

programme.title: 6 Below: Miracle on the Mountain
programme.desc: A thrill-seeking snowboarder gets lost in a winter storm, where he is forced to battle his own demons as he fights for survival. Adventure based on a true story, starring Josh Hartnett, Mira Sorvino and Sarah Dumont

programme.title: The Sentinel
programme.desc: Conspiracy thriller starring Michael Douglas and Kiefer Sutherland. US Secret Service agent Pete Garrison has dedicated his life to serving his country's leaders, until a failed lie detector test makes him the number one suspect in a plot to assassinate the current occupier of the White House. Garrison is forced on the run in a race against time to clear his name, pursued by top operative David Breckinridge, who has his own score to settle.

programme.title: The Negotiator
programme.desc: Action drama starring Samuel L Jackson and Kevin Spacey. Police hostage negotiator Danny Roman is informed by his partner that some of their colleagues are embezzling funds. When his partner is murdered, suspicion falls on Roman and he realises that he must take drastic action to clear his name.

programme.title: The Driver's Seat (Identikit)
programme.desc: A woman goes in search of a dangerous liaison. Director Giuseppe Patroni Griffi's drama, starring Elizabeth Taylor, Ian Bannen, Mona Washbourne and Guido Mannari

programme.title: Jamaica Inn
programme.desc: A smooth-talking nobleman leads a gang of scurvy cut-throats along the coastline of Cornwall, plundering wrecks which run aground on the rocky shores. Alfred Hitchcock's period adventure based on the Daphne du Maurier novel, starring Charles Laughton, Maureen O'Hara and Leslie Banks

programme.title: A Snapshot of Forever
programme.desc: A wedding photographer's happy small town life is turned upside down when a famous Hollywood actor shows up at her parent's lakeside vineyard for his sister's wedding. Romantic comedy, starring Natalie Dreyfuss and Anthony Konechny

programme.title: Back to Love
programme.desc: Erica returns to her hometown for the first time since her solder husband was killed in action. Arriving in time to attend her sister's wedding, Erica has mixed emotions about being back, a feeling only made worse when she realises she has lingering affections for her old friend Nate. Now, amid the chaos of an off-again-on-again wedding, the returning widow must decide whether the time is right to move on from her late spouse and give love another chance. Romantic drama, starring Courtney Ford

programme.title: The Sundowners
programme.desc: An Irish-born sheep drover moves from place to place across the Outback, enjoying the free-and-easy nature of his work. His wife and teenage son, however, are weary of the nomadic way of life and try to persuade him to settle down so they can get a mortgage on a farm. Adventure set in 1920s Australia, starring Robert Mitchum, Deborah Kerr, Peter Ustinov and Ronald Fraser

programme.title: City Lights
programme.desc: Classic silent comedy romance starring Charlie Chaplin and Virginia Cherrill. A lonely tramp becomes friends with an eccentric millionaire, and falls in love with a blind girl who sells flowers.

programme.title: Mothers of the Bride
programme.desc: A woman who was adopted decides she is ready to meet her biological mother as she prepares to get married, only to discover she is a famous event planner. She immediately clashes with the bride's adoptive mother as she tries to turn the simple ceremony into an extravagant spectacle. Comedy, starring Gail O'Grady, Betsy Brandt and Daniela Bobadilla

programme.title: 12 Days of Giving
programme.desc: Seasonal romance starring Ashley Jones and David Blue. A photographer uses his new-found wealth to act as a secret Santa to his community, and his acts of kindness bring him close to a single mother.

programme.title: A Song for Christmas
programme.desc: Seasonal romance starring Kelli Williams and Jonathan Scarfe. Two single parents start to fall in love only to learn that their daughters are arch rivals at school.

programme.title: The Return of Swamp Thing
programme.desc: Spoof sci-fi thriller starring Louis Jourdan, Heather Locklear and Sarah Douglas. Investigating her mother's mysterious death, Abby Arcane is unaware that her mad scientist stepfather plans to use her in his macabre genetic experiments. Help comes in the unlikely form of Swamp Thing.

programme.title: Along Came the Devil
programme.desc: Growing up wasn't easy for Ashley, and in her quest for belonging, she accidentally welcomes an evil presence, leaving her family and friends in a desperate battle to save her

programme.title: Natural Born Killers
programme.desc: Oliver Stone's controversial crime drama starring Woody Harrelson and Juliette Lewis. Psychopathic lovers Mickey and Mallory set out on a violent cross-country murder spree and become macabre media celebrities when the unrepentant Mickey annnounces that they're "natural born killers".

programme.title: What We Do in the Shadows
programme.desc: Horror comedy starring Jemaine Clement and Taika Waititi. Viago is a centuries-old vampire who shares a flat with three fellow bloodsuckers in present-day Wellington in New Zealand. The quartet struggles to fit into a modern world of paying rent and staying fashionable, until young Nick is turned into a vampire and decides to help them to adjust.

programme.title: Phantom Racer
programme.desc: When former friends and rival Nascar racers JJ SAWYER and CUTTER MCCONAUGHEY collide in a fiery accident on the track, only JJ survives. Sixteen years later, he is a guilt-ridden ‘truckie’ transporting race cars from track to track without a life. Unexpectedly stopping in his home town, JJ discovers that Cutter’s race car has been completely restored and now, because of JJ’s presence, it comes alive, haunted by its old driver. The car wants revenge and it wants JJ. Mile after brutal mile the highway becomes a battleground, resulting in a final confrontation which must bring an end to the frightening rampage of the Phantom Racer.

programme.title: The Little Shop of Horrors
programme.desc: Horror comedy starring Jonathan Haze and featuring Jack Nicholson. When dim-witted Seymour Krelboined develops a new breed of plant, his position at the Skid Row flower shop looks to be safe. The only problem is, his new creation craves human blood if it is to grow.

programme.title: Archie
programme.desc: Animated short. Archie is devastated to learn of the death of his beloved Aunt Betty and makes the long journey to the home she has left him in the Outer Hebrides

programme.title: A.R.C.H.I.E. 2 : Mission Impawsible
programme.desc: Super-smart A.I dog Archie (Michael J. Fox) befriends the son of a carnival owner while on a summer holiday. Family sequel.

programme.title: An Eskimo Tale
programme.desc: When animals start mysteriously disappearing, three young Inuits embark on a perilous journey to save their tribe from ruin. Animated adventure, with the voice of Christopher Plummer

programme.title: Angel and the Badman
programme.desc: Western starring John Wayne and Gail Russell. Pursued by armed horsemen, wounded and exhausted, hard-bitten outlaw Quirt Evans finds refuge on the ranch of a devout Quaker family. As he is nursed back to health, Quirt finds himself torn between his growing love for Quaker girl Penelope and the lure of an old score still to be settled.

programme.title: Somewhere in Time
programme.desc: Romantic drama starring Christopher Reeve and Jane Seymour. A cryptic message from an elderly lady and a captivating photograph from 1912 lead playwright Richard Collier to travel back through time in search of the beautiful Elise McKenna. There is, however, no guarantee that his heart's desire is attainable.

programme.title: Charade
programme.desc: Romantic comedy thriller starring Cary Grant, Audrey Hepburn and Walter Matthau. The body of a man hurtles from the carriage of a train speeding across the French countryside, and for Regina Lampert life becomes bewildering. It also becomes sinister when she returns to Paris to find her flat stripped bare. Who is telling the truth, and whom can she trust?

programme.title: Fixing Up Christmas
programme.desc: Romantic comedy starring Natalie Dreyfuss and Marshall Williams. Corporate party planner Joy is hired to help a young CEO with his festive jamboree. As they get to know each other, she finds she can "fix up" other areas of his life, too.

programme.title: Christmas on Holly Lane
programme.desc: Drama starring Sarah Lancaster, Karen Holness and Gina Holden. Three friends with troubled lives who meet every year for Christmas fear this might be their last together.

programme.title: JFK
programme.desc: Historical thriller based on events surrounding the assassination of President John F Kennedy, starring Kevin Costner. On 22 November 1963, President Kennedy's death changes America for ever. Initially, an angry and saddened nation is satisfied with the guilt of Lee Harvey Oswald. But, as the years pass, unease, disillusionment and cynicism set in. New Orleans prosecutor Jim Garrison is convinced of a conspiracy, and sets out to prove it.

programme.title: Watching the Detectives
programme.desc: Drama about a man whose quiet life running a video store is turned upside down by a beautiful and adventurous woman

programme.title: Alex of Venice
programme.desc: An attorney is obsessively focused on her career, but is forced to rethink her life when her husband unexpectedly leaves her. She finds herself forced to contend with the daily grind of her family's lives, and finds an unexpected new strength as she struggles to hold them together. Drama, starring Mary Elizabeth Winstead and Don Johnson

programme.title: Made for You with Love
programme.desc: Romantic drama starring Edy Ganem and Brendon Zub. A dressmaker who makes a living by upcycling second-hand wedding gowns discovers that fixing her love life is a trickier task.

programme.title: A Wizard's Tale
programme.desc: A teenage lad is transported to a magical land, where he teams up with a princess to stop a mean wizard called The Grump who casts a spell to banish happiness from the area. Animated adventure, featuring the voices of Toby Kebbell, Lily Collins and Ian McShane

programme.title: An Eskimo Tale
programme.desc: When animals start mysteriously disappearing, three young Inuits embark on a perilous journey to save their tribe from ruin. Animated adventure, with the voice of Christopher Plummer

programme.title: A Christmas Story
programme.desc: The perfect Christmas story for all the family. Join eight-year old Julius as he embarks on a magical journey! Growing up in an orphanage, Julius has always been a bit of an outsider. However, one day he is wondrously transported to a frosty and enchanted world where, with the help of Herman the marzipan pig and Sophina the glass angel, he sets off to save Santa from the wicked hands of Crampus.

programme.title: Eagle's Wing
programme.desc: Western starring Martin Sheen and Sam Waterston. 1840s: City-bred trapper Pike learns to survive in hostile terrain following his companion's death at the hands of a tribal war party. But his ownership of a magnificent white stallion - the Eagle's Wing - brings him into deadly conflict with White Bull, a Kiowa warrior.

programme.title: The Lady Vanishes
programme.desc: Classic thriller starring Margaret Lockwood and Michael Redgrave. One moment Miss Froy was sitting there, on the London-bound train from the Tyrol. The next she had vanished. Some passengers claimed she was never there, but Iris Henderson is convinced that she saw her. Was it her imagination?

programme.title: Tim
programme.desc: Romantic drama based on Colleen McCullough's bestselling novel, starring Piper Laurie and Mel Gibson. Tim is a picture of sheer physical beauty, a mild-mannered 24-year-old whom Mary Horton longs to take under her wing. The problem is that Mary is a woman in her 40s and Tim has a child-like IQ. What will everyone think if they have a relationship?

programme.title: 12 Days of Giving
programme.desc: Seasonal romance starring Ashley Jones and David Blue. A photographer uses his new-found wealth to act as a secret Santa to his community, and his acts of kindness bring him close to a single mother.

programme.title: Christmas Hero
programme.desc: Romantic drama starring Anna Hutchison. When firefighter Jenny falls in love with Tom she gets caught in the middle of a custody battle between Tom and his bitter ex-wife.

programme.title: Meet the Spartans
programme.desc: Spoof of 300 and other historic battle movies, starring Sean Maguire and Carmen Electra. King Leonidas of Sparta leads his men in a battle against troops led by Persian ruler Xerxes, while Leonidas's wife, Queen Margo, makes her own war effort.

programme.title: Buster
programme.desc: Crime drama based on the life of Great Train Robber Buster Edwards, starring Phil Collins and Julie Walters. A small-time crook gets the chance to move into the big time when he becomes part of a gang planning to rob the Royal Mail train of more than £2 million - a crime that will go down in history.

programme.title: Lady Chatterley's Lover
programme.desc: She was beautiful and sensual, trapped in a loveless marriage. He was her husband's servant. Born into worlds as far apart, they found a passionate world of their own.

programme.title: Blood In The Water
programme.desc: A young, guilt-ridden woman is forced into a game of Russian roulette with a great white shark and others who have escaped the law. Horror.

programme.title: Love on Harbor Island
programme.desc: When a young woman called Lily returns to her hometown to help her Aunt Maggie run a bed and breakfast, she meets Marcus, a handsome pilot. Romantic drama, starring Morgan Kohan, Marcus Rosner, Brenda Matthews and Emma Cam

programme.title: Karen Kingsbury's The Bridge
programme.desc: Two new students at nearby Belmont University, Ryan and Molly, meet the first day of classes and become study partners. The Bridge, a local bookstore, becomes a close part of their lives as their relationship grows.

programme.title: The Christmas Cure
programme.desc: Romantic drama starring Brooke Nevin. A woman returns to her home town for Christmas before taking up a job promotion at the hospital where she works. But personal and family circumstances make her think twice about ever going back.

programme.title: McLintock!
programme.desc: Comedy western starring John Wayne and Maureen O'Hara. McLintock is a ranch owner who hires Louise Warren to cook for him and help around the house. Her son Devlin is also taken on as a ranch hand. Everything seems to be working out fine until McLintock's estranged wife returns from back East, seeking a divorce and custody of their teenage daughter.

programme.title: Radio Rebel
programme.desc: Timid schoolgirl Tara tries to hide her double life as the author of a daily podcast. Her father, the boss of a popular radio station, encourages her to host a live show in the studio, and the broadcast becomes a big hit with her fellow pupils. However, the school's strict principal disapproves and takes action to silence her. Drama, starring Debby Ryan, Sarena Parmar and Adam di Marco

programme.title: A Cinderella Christmas
programme.desc: Romance starring Emma Rigby and Peter Porte. Put-upon party planner Angie meets handsome bachelor Nikolaus at a masked ball. But after she leaves without telling him who she is, Nikolaus is determined to track her down.

programme.title: Meet Me in New York
programme.desc: Kelly is a young, creative, ambitious events planner in New York City and quickly gaining a reputation as one of the best in the business. But when Joe, a stubborn, difficult, but influential website editor, hires her to organize his niece's 10th birthday party, Kelly quickly realizes that she may have just met her match.

programme.title: Before You Say I Do
programme.desc: Fantasy romantic comedy starring David Sutcliffe and Jennifer Westfeldt. George is deeply in love with Jane, but she's reluctant to walk down the aisle again because her first marriage ended badly. Then George is given the chance to change Jane's view of matrimony when he's propelled back in time.

programme.title: Father's Little Dividend
programme.desc: Comedy starring Spencer Tracy, Joan Bennett and Elizabeth Taylor. Stanley Banks is looking forward to some peace and quiet now that his daughter is married. But his plans are disrupted when she announces that she is going to have a baby.

programme.title: A Little Something for Your Birthday
programme.desc: Romantic comedy starring Sharon Stone and Tony Goldwyn. Senna's life has not turned out how she had hoped. But, every year on her birthday, her lack of career and romantic success weighs more and more heavily, and her 50th is approaching...

programme.title: Sirens
programme.desc: Erotic comedy starring Hugh Grant, Tara FitzGerald and Sam Neill. Australia, the 1930s: when a controversial painting planned to be exhibited by artist Norman Lindsay offends the church, a young vicar who has just arrived from England is sent to Lindsay's home to try to persuade him to withdraw the work.

programme.title: Deadly Dormitory
programme.desc: When a University student refuses to sleep with her professor in exchange for good grades, she's in danger of being killed to keep her quiet, and her mother must drop everything to save her. Romantic drama, starring Grace Patterson

programme.title: Hangman
programme.desc: A family finds they have been burgled, but are unaware the intruder is lurking in their attic with further terror in mind. Thriller, with Jeremy Sisto, Kate Ashfield (Shaun of the Dead) and Ryan Simpkins

programme.title: The Wedding Ring
programme.desc: At her sister's wedding, jewellery designer Kate encounters her childhood sweetheart. Will she finally see a ring slipped on her own finger? Romantic drama, starring Lauren Lee Smith and Dillon Casey

programme.title: An En Vogue Christmas
programme.desc: Desperate to save her late father's legacy when his club is foreclosed on, Kendall and her friends put on a Christmas concert to keep it in business. Drama, starring Terry Ellis, Cindy Herron, Rhona Bennett and Genelle Williams

programme.title: Nine Lives of Christmas
programme.desc: After a stray cat adopts Zachary, he meets Marilee and realizes the single life is not as fulfilling as he thought it was.

programme.title: The Snows of Kilimanjaro
programme.desc: Romantic drama based on an Ernest Hemingway short story, starringGregory Peck, Susan Hayward and Ava Gardner. A writer looks back on his varied life and the women he has loved as he lies badly injured in a camp site beneath the snow-capped peak of Mount Kilimanjaro.

programme.title: A Time to Dance
programme.desc: Determined not to spoil their daughter's wedding, a couple postpone their separation and try to put aside their differences for the big day. Drama based on Karen Kingsbury's novel, starring Jennie Garth, Corbin Bernsen and Fiona Vroom

programme.title: A Fairytale Christmas
programme.desc: Aka Christmas Belle. With her California hometown in the rearview mirror, Belle heads north on business to facilitate the estate sale of a mansion. While the job is a dream, the client, Hunter Lowell, is not. But, as the two spend more time together, his icy demeanour begins to melt. Although their relationship is budding, Belle's long-time suitor, Tony, arrives, sending mixed signals to Hunter while adding chaos to the holiday season.

programme.title: How to Find Forever
programme.desc: Marley's brilliant at organizing other people's engagements, but unlucky in finding romance herself. When designing her most important proposal yet, the man who could jeopardize it all may be the one who helps find her own love story.

programme.title: Inside Out
programme.desc: Adventure comedy starring Telly Savalas, Robert Culp and James Mason. An ex-PoW returns to Germany 30 years after the Second World War and teams up with his former prison camp commander to find a wartime cache of gold. But only one man knows where it is - a Nazi war criminal who is in a high-security prison. An elaborate plan is hatched to kidnap him and force him to reveal the whereabouts of the gold.

programme.title: The Intergalactic Adventures of Max Cloud
programme.desc: Brooklyn, 1990, and when teenager Sarah is transported beyond the TV screen and into her most played game, she finds herself trapped on intergalactic prison planet Heinous, home to the most dangerous villains in the galaxy, including the bizarre Revengor and evil sorceress Shee. The only way to escape is to complete the levels. Teaming up with space hero, Max Cloud, they must take on terrifying tyrants with a little help from her not-so-savvy best friend, Cowboy, controlling the console from her bedroom. Sci-fi comedy, starring Scott Adkins, John Hannah and Lashana Lynch

programme.title: The Recall
programme.desc: A no-nonsense survivalist tools up and takes the fight to invading extra-terrestrial hordes. Sci-fi thriller, starring Wesley Snipes, RJ Mitte and Jedidiah Goodacre

programme.title: Universal Soldier: Regeneration
programme.desc: A dead soldier who was brought back to life as the ultimate killing machine is revived once more to deal with terrorists who have taken control of a nuclear reactor. He finds his enemies not only have a more advanced reanimated soldier in their ranks, but they have also resurrected an old foe of his. Sci-fi thriller sequel, starring Jean-Claude Van Damme and Dolph Lundgren
